ACTL-M1.description: Main Analysis Control (ACTL-M1). Single global analysis-control record (key is always "1"); the flags govern general solver behavior and the optional TCELEM object drives nonlinear time-step (tension/compression element) control and convergence criteria.

ARCD.description: Auto Rotational DOF Constraint. Automatically constrain unconnected rotational degrees of freedom.

ANRC.description: Auto Normal Rotation Constraint. Automatically constrain the in-plane (drilling) rotation of plate/shell elements.

CSECF.description: Consider Section Stiffness Scale Factor when computing element stiffness.

TRS.description: Transfer Reactions to Master Node for rigid-link / master-slave connections.

CLATS.description: Change Local Axis of Tapered Section.

CLFORM.description: Use the Classical Formula for Solid Element.

CABINIT.description: Consider Initial Tension for Cable Element.

BSCHG.description: Beam Section Property Changes (case-insensitive). CONSTANT = keep the original section, CHANGE = allow the section property to change.

TCELEM.description: Nonlinear time-step control (tension/compression element). Optional; when omitted the solver applies its default convergence setup (Displacement check enabled at 0.001, Load/Work disabled).

NUMINC.description: Number of Increments (load steps) for the nonlinear analysis.

INTOUT.description: Intermediate Output Request (case-insensitive). EVERY = output at every increment, LAST = output at the last increment only.

CONVERGENCE.description: Convergence Criteria. Each sub-object (DISPL/LOAD/WORK) enables a convergence check and supplies its tolerance.

VALUE.description: Convergence Tolerance Value. Used when OPT_USE is true (handler default 0.001 if omitted).
Convergence Tolerance Value. Required by the handler when OPT_USE is true (a missing VALUE with OPT_USE=true is rejected).
